description: E32 — 尼姆佐-印度防御，Rfe1连接→Re2前进→Rde1叠车

intro.popup_en: Connecting the Rooks, Lesson 3: After connecting the rooks, go one step further and double them on the same file. Two rooks on one file create powerful combined pressure. White completes the e-file doubling in three moves.
intro.popup:
链接双车第3课
连接之后，更进一步——叠车！
两辆车叠在同一列，火力翻倍！
看白方三步完成e列双车叠压！

outro.popup_en: Rfe1 connects the rooks, Re2 advances the front rook, and Rde1 doubles the second rook behind it. Re2 and Re1 create concentrated pressure on the e-file, a classic way to amplify rook power.
outro.popup:
总结：Rfe1连接 → Re2前进 → Rde1叠车！
Re2+Re1 = e列叠车，双重压制！
叠车是双车加大威力的经典手段！

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center in this Queen's Pawn opening.
moves.popup:
d4控制中心
后翼开局

moves.popup_en: c4! The Queen's Gambit challenges d5.
Nc3! White develops the second minor piece and supports d4.
moves.popup:
Nc3！轻子出动第2步
支援d4

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4! The Nimzo-Indian bishop pins Nc3 and adds pressure to White's center.
moves.popup:
Bb4！尼姆佐-印度防御！
钉住Nc3

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles, completing the second step. The rooks are nearly connected.
moves.popup:
O-O！易位完成！三步曲第二步！
白方双车连接即将完成！

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 exchanges pawns and begins to open the e-file.
moves.popup:
cxd4黑方兑换
e列逐渐开放

moves.popup_en: exd4! The e-file is now semi-open and becomes White's main attacking route.
moves.popup:
exd4！e列半开放！
e列成为白方的主攻方向！

moves.popup_en: ...dxc4 exchanges pawns and reactivates White's bishop.
moves.popup:
dxc4黑方兑换
白方象重新激活

moves.popup_en: Rfe1!! The third step is complete: the rook from f1 enters the e-file, connecting White's rooks along the back rank.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！！三步曲第三步——双车连接！
Rf1→e1，进入e列！
连接完成：Ra1——Rd1——Re1

moves.popup_en: ...Bb7 develops Black's bishop and controls the g2-a8 diagonal.
moves.popup:
Bb7黑象出动
控制g2-a8斜线

moves.popup_en: Rad1! The rook from a1 moves to the d-file. White now assigns one rook to e-file and the other to d-file.
moves.popup:
Rad1！Ra1→d列！
双车分控：Re1（e列）+ Rd1（d列）

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black also occupies the e-file and contests it.
moves.popup:
Re8！黑方车也进e列！
争夺e列

moves.popup_en: Re2!! The front rook advances toward the seventh rank, clearing e1 so the rook from d1 can join it.
moves.popup:
Re2！！第一辆车前进！
Re1→e2，向第7排推进！
同时为Rd1→e1腾出位置！

moves.popup_en: Rde1!! The doubling is complete: the rook from d1 joins the rook on e2. With Re2 in front and Re1 behind, White doubles on the e-file and targets the seventh rank.
moves.popup:
Rde1！！叠车完成！
Rd1→e1，双车全部进入e列！
Re2（前）+ Re1（后）= e列叠车！
火力翻倍，直指黑方第7排！
